aj: Quick QA for onboarding rwdx-slim — weights are staged at gs://redwood-models/rwdx-slim/v1, but tokenizer is acting funky in our chat templates. Can folks confirm expected BOS/EOS handling?

marie: I pulled the weights and the tokenizer files are under /tokenizer/vocab.json + merges. Initial glance: special_tokens: {"bos": "<s>", "eos": "</s>"} but the tokenizer emits a separate '\n' token before the first non-whitespace token for some inputs.

logan: Yeah noticed that with `"\nHello"` -> tokens showing `[<s>, "\n", "Hello"]` instead of `[<s>, "Hello"]`. That breaks our prompt prefixing because we assume no extra whitespace token after BOS.

aj: Ugh. Do we want to strip the leading newline automatically in the prompt formatter or teach the tokenizer wrapper to drop a sentinel after BOS? Which is less risky for generation stats?

sahil: Preference = safer change in our wrapper: add `strip_leading_bos` toggle on model config so we don't alter raw tokenizer behavior. That way we can A/B without changing model artifacts. Small config sample:

```
model:
  name: rwdx-slim
  path: gs://redwood-models/rwdx-slim/v1
  tokenizer:
    special_tokens: {"bos": "<s>", "eos": "</s>"}
    strip_leading_bos: true
```

marie: +1 for config toggle. Also add quick unit test that tokenizes `"\nHello"` and asserts the wrapper returns tokens without the intermediate newline when `strip_leading_bos = true`.

logan: I'll add the wrapper change and tests. Quick question: if we strip, do we also need to adjust prefix caching (KV cache keys) since token offsets shift?

sahil: Good catch — cache keys should remain based on post-normalized tokens. Add a short note in the model config docs that strip affects prefix hash.

aj: Can someone run a tiny canary with the wrapper flag on dedicated canary pool after tests? I don't want to flip this globally before a smoke run.

logan: On it. Will push branch and tag for canary. pinging deploy-bot to schedule.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued for pool "onboard-rwdx". Will run post-merge smoke (3 requests @ short-context). Results will be posted here. :gear:

marie: One last thing — please add an example snippet in the onboarding checklist showing the tokenization diffs (before/after) so support can explain to customers why we added strip flag.

aj: Thanks — that's the plan. Assigning follow-ups: logan -> wrapper+tests+canary, marie -> docs snippet, sahil -> config doc note on cache hashing. I'll drop the PR link once ready. :thumbsup:
